verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships an on-device iPhone app built on Swift + MLX Swift, Apple's framework for its own silicon, and a native Rust macOS CLI/daemon/desktop app. Together these suggest Apple Silicon-targeted execution, but no doc explicitly claims Metal kernels, ARM/NEON optimizations, or Apple Silicon speedups. Missing for 10: explicit Metal/GPU acceleration docs for macOS, Apple Silicon-specific benchmarks, ARM-native optimization details, independent hands-on corroboration.
